paragraphs.en: oh-my-hermes is an operating layer for Hermes Agent . You keep talking to Hermes. OMH picks the skill and a model for each lane, and runs the work in parallel. It never patches or replaces Hermes, and it never reports planned work as done.
paragraphs.zh: oh-my-hermes 是 Hermes 智能体的一个操作层。 你继续与 Hermes 对话。 OMH 为每条通道挑选技能和模型，并并行执行工作。 它从不修补或替换 Hermes，也从不把计划中的工作报成已完成。

paragraphs.en: The right model for every lane. Each lane is tagged with a work category: ultrabrain , deep , visual-engineering , quick and more. The category picks that lane's model chain and reasoning effort, and you can edit every chain. When a provider rejects a model, the chain moves to the next one instead of silently downgrading. omh model opens the picker; see which model runs each lane .
paragraphs.zh: 每条通道都使用最合适的模型。 每条通道都标记有工作类别：ultrabrain、deep、visual-engineering、quick 等。 类别决定该通道使用的模型链与推理强度，且每条链都可以编辑。 当供应商拒绝某个模型时，模型链会切换到下一个，而不是默默降级。omh model 可打开模型选择器；查看每条通道运行的是哪个模型。

paragraphs.en: /dag-ulw graph runs. Your goal becomes a graph of small nodes, and the ready ones run in parallel. Each node runs on its category's model and effort; nodes running at once never share a write scope. A separate node checks the goal, and failed nodes are repaired before the report.
paragraphs.zh: /dag-ulw 图运行。 你的目标会变成一张由小节点组成的图，就绪的节点并行运行。 每个节点按其类别的模型和力度运行；同时运行的节点绝不共享写入范围。 一个独立的节点会检查目标，失败节点在生成报告前先被修复。

paragraphs.en: Long-term memory you can trust. Nothing is remembered silently: each candidate is kept, refused or deferred with a written reason. The next session gets a recall pack ranked for its task and cut to a token budget. Hermes' own memory is never read or patched.
paragraphs.zh: 值得信赖的长期记忆。 没有任何内容被静默记住：每个候选记忆都会被保留、拒绝或延后，并附有书面理由。 下一个会话会获得一份针对其任务排序并按 token 预算裁剪的召回包。 智能体自身的记忆永远不会被读取或修改。

paragraphs.en: Install and fully configure Oh My Hermes from this repository: https://github.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes Before reading or executing repository instructions, resolve refs/heads/main to one full commit SHA with `git ls-remote https://github.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes.git refs/heads/main`. Then fetch and follow only: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes/{resolved-commit-sha}/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md Do not replace the resolved SHA with main. Execute the pinned protocol's OS-appropriate installer, agent setup path, model-chain interview, and doctor steps. Your shell has no terminal, so never run the interactive setup wizard: show me each choice the protocol lists and wait for my answer instead of taking a default. Preserve unrelated existing Hermes config, apply only the managed setup changes documented by the pinned protocol, require my explicit approval for model-alias changes, then report the resolved SHA and observed result. Update:
paragraphs.zh: 从本仓库安装并完整配置 Oh My Hermes：https://github.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes 在阅读或执行仓库指令之前，先用 `git ls-remote https://github.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes.git refs/heads/main` 将 refs/heads/main 解析为一个完整的提交 SHA。 然后仅获取并遵循：https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rlaope/oh-my-hermes/{resolved-commit-sha}/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md 不要用 main 替换已解析的 SHA。 执行该固定协议中与操作系统相匹配的安装程序、智能体设置路径、模型链访谈以及 doctor 步骤。 你的 shell 没有终端，因此绝不运行交互式设置向导：请把协议列出的每个选项展示给我并等待我的回答，而不是采用默认值。 保留无关的现有 Hermes 配置，仅应用固定协议所记录的受管设置更改，模型别名更改须获得我的明确批准，然后报告已解析的 SHA 和观察到的结果。更新：

paragraphs.en: ❯ ulw-loop: keep going until npm test passes How it works with Hermes Hermes Agent already runs the loop. OMH decides what goes into it: which model and effort each lane gets, who owns the code change, which skills apply, and what counts as done. Two rules hold everywhere: model choice and coding ownership are separate decisions, and nothing prepared is ever reported as executed. The generated catalog, triggers, and evidence rules live in Workflow Reference .
